items.title: HTB: PingPong
items.summary: PingPong is an assume breach Active Directory box with two forests joined by a bidirectional trust. I’ll abuse ESC13 to get a certificate whose issuance policy maps to a group with WinRM access, and get a shell on the first DC. From there, I’ll tunnel to the second forest, convert a global group to domain local so I can add my user from across the trust, and read a gMSA password. That gMSA account is limited to a constrained JEA endpoint, which I’ll escape with script blocks to find credentials in a PowerShell history file.
